chunks: And when the wild beasts are gathered
ai.seo_question: What happens to wild animals on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a literal gathering of beasts to testify against their oppressors, highlighting the cosmic justice of the Hereafter. Scholars like Allamah Tabatabai emphasize that this phenomenon serves as a tangible sign for humanity, demonstrating that even non-rational creatures will bear witness to human transgressions on the Day of Resurrection.
